verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own pricing page says the phone system plugs into CRMs such as Salesforce and HubSpot, which is first-party CRM integration. But no evidence shows that calls and texts are logged automatically, or that they are matched to the right contact record. The call-log API and Workflow Builder are only building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented automatic call logging to CRM, documented SMS logging to CRM, contact-matching behavior, CRM integration docs detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts log to my CRM automatically against the right contact

citations.quote: plug in your phone system to all the different apps your business runs on - like Salesforce, Hubspot, Zendesk, ServiceNow, and many more
